messages.subject: Coursera and Shiny?
parts:
We are looking into using Coursera as an Learning Management System (LMS). I found an interesting article about folks using Javascipt to implement tools for students to use (e.g., a system solver). See link below.

http://vazexqi.github.io/posts/2013/04/20/javascript-tools-in-coursera.html

While this is nice it requires extensive knowledge of Javascript which I do not have :) I am wondering if/how Shiny could be used (or called) as an alternative.
